content: We need to determine number of carbonyl groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the compound. We can use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool (expensive) maybe cheaper to use IR first. IR will show carbonyl stretch around 1700 cm-1. Could be ambiguous but we can count peaks. Probably need both. Use IR first.
